item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.27

Released on 2026-11-09.

Studio renders now wait for the same one-at-a-time render slot as the CLI, so two renders no longer split one machine between them. Long project paths on Windows and the macOS developer-tools prompt are fixed too.

Features

  • Skills: Route a style outside the templates instead of listing them (37f1819f3, #7450).
  • CLI: Reverse and templates report their own runs; commands say which skills are installed (448f88ff3, #7444).
  • Skills: Reverse-any-video and style-sampling install with the core set (ad6f7858f, #7445).
  • Producer: Distributed and range renders honour page motion blur (c38ac5438, #7311).
  • CLI: Add agent markers other detectors use, verified upstream (7bf65995b, #7425).
  • CLI: Detect more agent runtimes in telemetry (c14f25890, #7423).

Fixes

  • CLI: Studio renders take the same one-render-slot lock as the CLI (4b3f70fb1, #7459).
  • CLI: Templates pull unpacks under .hyperframes, not beside templates/ (a4e16d87c, #7269).
  • Skills: Await the player seek in seam-gate (fc13420de, #7454).
  • CLI: Label SVG contact sheet thumbnails by file name on Windows (0ca2b1ae9, #6732).
  • CLI: Staging folders beside a project path no longer fail past 260 characters on Windows (b59fa2083, #7338).
  • CLI: No macOS developer-tools prompt from git, xcrun or cc checks on a Mac without the tools (c14973081, #7257).
  • CLI: Transcribe reads whisper output with nan or inf values (7b30a50b5, #7110).
  • CLI: Spaced-path hint takes the longest path and reads --flag=value; telemetry docs name the reverse session id (3a24da8a8, #7452).
  • Core: Detect template entries structurally (caa62fe68, #7249).
  • CLI: Measure answers the four mistakes agents make most (eb0a52c29, #7443).
  • Core: A video held on its tail is seeked once, not every frame (a73572c3b, #7442).
  • CLI: Let an agent's own name beat editor and host markers (c1e96a45b, #7424).

Docs & Examples

  • Mcp: Current ChatGPT and Claude setup steps, the hosted render's real output, and a first prompt that works (48a2b4e01, #7439).
  • Changelog: Weekly digest 2026-11-02-2026-11-09 (3ff0b3d81, #7453).
  • CLI: Correct Claude Code marker comments in agent detection (e35125372, #7426).
  • List the 1440p presets in the v0.9.26 notes (d09584382, #7422).

Internal

  • Engine: Nightly motion blur run over generated compositions (7bf19ab5f, #7437).
  • Engine: Real-Chrome tests get 30 s per test on slow runners, not 5 s (4d29a64b0, #7456).
  • Codegen: Resync the generated cloud client (b95ab794e, #7455).
  • Engine: Drive the empty-screenshot probe test with fake timers (c9fe04150, #7000).

Full changelog

item.title: v0.9.25
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.25

Released on 2026-11-08.

Re-rendering a film with the same settings now gives the same result, because every render seeds its random values. A muted video's picture also no longer waits on its own audio track at a cut, and check replays an unchanged project's last pass.

Features

  • CLI: Check replays an unchanged project's last pass and takes --no-craft (070b964d7, #7398).

Fixes

  • Core: A muted video's picture no longer waits on its own audio track at a cut (fa2e63515, #7412).
  • Producer: Seed random values in every render so re-renders give the same film (eb16510a1, #7410).
  • Core: Capture pages load only the clips on screen (12906e0bf, #7402).

Internal

  • Install ffmpeg through the GitHub API asset route with a cache (074de9dd1, #7401).

Released on 2026-11-08.

Fade-ins that follow a starting set now end fully visible instead of vanishing when the fade finishes. Failed script reports also name their library, and menu highlights match their panel.

Internal

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.21

Released on 2026-11-07.

Cloud exports take big files and files given by full path, HDR clips keep their brightness, and Safari's picture meets the cut again.

Features

  • CLI: Cloud uploads send a big file in parts, so a cut connection resends one part (3d7f12acd, #7375).
  • Media Use: The voice credits line names the real source, your recording or any vendor (f5bde9533, #7380).
  • Media Use: Your own voice recording is a voice line, and speed applies to it (14e598e5a, #7377).

Fixes

  • Core: Safari video picture lands on the cut again, undoing the hidden pre-roll (841e90ffe, #7383).
  • CLI: A media file referenced by its filesystem path goes into the cloud archive (e0c11bf09, #7381).
  • Check: Lint and check skip compositions the project never mounts (7b79ab429, #7369).
  • Engine: Hlg footage with a large header sei also tone-maps at hlg's white (b559a98d3, #7349).
  • CLI: A re-encode of a media file over the cap is limited to fit it (57a75337b, #7376).
  • Core: A film moves on past a video the browser never starts loading (a595755a3, #7368).
  • Producer: Page timers during a render run on film time (59c2065d6, #7362).
  • CLI: Transcribe names why whisper is missing and the one line that fixes it (9efbbdf5a, #7366).
  • Check: Masked or clipped-away text no longer counts as overlapping (a3b8f521d, #7364).
  • Check: The overlap finding names the decorative mark, data-layout-ignore (330be7cd2, #7365).
  • CLI: Open stops the project's background preview first (896a77c30, #7297).
  • CLI: Stop waiting for the cloud's file check when the caller aborts (336abaa80, #7361).
  • Check: A Chrome that never becomes ready ends the check with a named error (e827de256, #7360).

Performance

  • Producer: Size a long video's chunks in one plan, no re-plan (c27475b97, #7382).

Internal

  • CLI: The cloud upload's PUT and retry code moves to its own file (b418bb24f, #7374).
  • Player: A Safari perf run that fails says which wait timed out and why (7b1d9cceb, #7347).

Full changelog

item.title: v0.9.20
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.20

Released on 2026-11-07.

Cloud export of footage cuts works again, Safari no longer freezes on a video stuck at its header, and any video format nobody listed now gets a playable copy instead of a blank card.

Features

  • Check: Name the saved report file and print one stderr line per check step (9ac2a2387, #7344).
  • CLI: Audio --read --layer reads a one-layer file whole, no separation (b37db1122, #7345).
  • Studio: Type an exact preview zoom and see a pixel grid at high zoom (25a61016d, #5708).
  • Studio: Improve element picker cancellation feedback (f004622a6, #6900).
  • Studio: Show canvas gesture position, size and rotation (a4a84deec, #5594).
  • CLI: Support JSON telemetry status (6c0cab814, #7289).
  • CLI: The sign-in page the browser lands on follows the design (9acdce4a2, #7332).
  • Studio: Show the agent's storyboard in a Storyboard tab beside the preview (318724f5f, #7284).
  • Core: Motion blur reports what a composition holds, as counts (a874a6324, #7306).
  • CLI: Check_report counts the browser-playable copies a check waited for (de2d21a8a, #7316).
  • CLI: Check_report names the finding that stopped the check (9fcd06cbb, #7305).
  • Core: Auto motion blur draws with the filter tier (e2bb7da25, #7288).
  • Share: Extract shared review kernel for local hosts (f54b2227f, #7134).
  • CLI: A line_unread finding carries the frames it measured around where the line was first read (a81b34410, #7294).

Fixes

  • CLI: Cloud upload tests stop flaking and two cuts at the same age count as one (555c788a3, #7352).
  • Core: Skip a video the browser can't decode instead of freezing the film (9058fd1a7, #7355).
  • Studio Server: A video with a codec nobody listed gets a playable preview copy (cf75dfd7a, #7356).
  • CLI: Cloud render zip carries files the composition references under dot-folders (6161ae740, #7353).
  • Studio Server: MPEG-2 and DNxHD videos get a playable preview copy (6004508e6, #7348).
  • CLI: A cloud upload cut at a fixed age stops early and shows its progress (65c62f314, #7350).
  • Check: A Korean number and its counter count as one word in line reading time (bc2773d04, #7343).
  • Core: Words in a scene the preview mounts later keep their spaces (1ddd42558, #7342).
  • Lint: Flag crypto.randomUUID() as non-deterministic (cc7a760f0, #7322).
  • Core: A render no longer rewinds when a set sits beside a tween on another property (539c70cee, #7339).
  • CLI: Price GPT Image 2.6 and every GPT Image reference picture (ab50e9c14, #7307).
  • Engine: A missing frame file skips its self-verify sample instead of aborting the render (cfa0d0cef, #7334).
  • Producer: A failure before the first frame reports frame capture as its stage (fe0f54b38, #7331).
  • Engine: A render no longer finishes without an image that loaded late (a9a8d8937, #7304).
  • Producer: Segmented capture gives up on a session stuck opening or initializing (6fab21914, #7329).
  • Engine: DrawElement falls back on gpu-less linux and beginframe launches instead of hanging self-verify (18fc75dcd, #7324).
  • Core: A set that interrupts a tween holds in a real render at any worker count (3e3ba8d0d, #7318).
  • Producer: Render reads a composition src like the preview, refuses paths outside (4cf26b5b4, #7317).
  • Skills: Reverse hands billing commands to the person instead of running them (410a516ce, #7314).
  • Core: A decoded buffer's handover leaves the routed element silent (cb8e02e82, #7309).
  • Studio Server: Proxy MPEG-4 Part 2 and MJPEG video the browser cannot decode (f3e45b492, #7310).
  • Templates: Pin the five style-sampling packs with the release-check fixes (9e2510bda, #7263).
  • CLI: Media-use voices says whose clones it lists, and --voice takes language codes (fc0b53361, #7261).
  • Core: Video starts a second early and catches up hidden, so the picture meets the cut (3e86def58, #7265).
  • CLI: Cloud render logs a line a minute while a job holds its status (41b7aeeaf, #7262).
  • CLI: Installing Chrome on a busy Windows PC no longer takes ten minutes (8fd754207, #7301).
  • Core: Accented Latin letters draw in a bundled family at its bundled weights (6011d9d0d, #7299).
  • Studio: Pressing Shift no longer re-renders the timeline (66cbabc39, #7298).
  • Core: A mover's ::before and ::after outside its box stay in the blur (4bee04e4a, #7295).
  • Core: A mover holding a fixed child stays sharp in the filter tier (b6f2bec16, #7292).
  • Core: The filter tier's svg no longer changes which child is last in the root (2066a2ff5, #7293).
  • Core: Blur quiets discrete callbacks instead of undoing what they wrote (cd7e93baa, #7271).

Internal

  • Engine: The effect scan resolves its options before scanning (ca64c2a6d, #7336).
  • Studio: Kill and retry a test Chrome that hangs after it starts listening (d2b170ce5, #7337).
  • Engine: Blur gates fail on CI when they cannot run, and prove blur drew (07824098e, #7302).

Full changelog

Released on 2026-11-05.

  • Producer: A capture segment extracts the frames it shows and deletes them (599eaad2b, #7241).
  • CLI: Check --budget stops the whole check in time and reports what it found (b7d72c947, #7245).
  • CLI: Info --media lists every clip the render hears, on the film's clock (df54f380c, #7235).

Fixes

  • CLI: Check judges SVG gradient text by its gradient stops, not as black (478ef2f26, #7258).
  • Engine: Name a failed script's origin and error before the free text of its warning (7290ee68c, #7256).
  • CLI: Normalize-audio --reference stops short of the peak ceiling instead of refusing (2f2195515, #7254).
  • Producer: Segmented and sequential capture check drawElement samples (8df4f21c2, #7255).
  • Core: Two scenes drawing SVGs with the same ids each show their own (b108f8512, #7251).
  • CLI: End a stalled cloud upload and send it again (f98218a22, #7237).
  • Core: Decode WebKit sources by memory budget, not by length (600bfa451, #7232).
  • Core: Snapshot and preview show a clip on the frame render shows it (5377b756b, #7238).
  • Producer: An export over the peak ceiling loses only what it must (d40d0b251, #7246).
  • Lint: Every selector in a comma list counts as hidden by authored CSS (a664f99ec, #7252).
  • Core: The bundle's contract check reads a timeline registered in a local script (0b3559824, #7248).
  • CLI: Check sees an SVG stroke drawing on, so it no longer calls it a dead stretch (644b166e7, #7250).
  • CLI: An unknown command answers in a few lines and says what to run instead (0a6746e1d, #7247).

  • CLI: Bound the loopback Studio probe so a dropped connection costs 1 s, not 10 (6e8454d6d, #6466).
  • CLI: Lint and check accept --lint-verbose, and two skills stop teaching --describe false (924bb64da, #7201).

  • Registry: Add path-traced-3d example with raster preview and path-traced export (d452a6fad, #7219).

  • Engine: Pin the motion blur sweep defects A to O by their symptoms (f3e5b81df, #7149).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.7

Released on 2026-11-03.

Studio playback no longer freezes WebGL scenes when motion blur is on. Preview playback now lands on the same frame as a scrub or an export when a set cuts into a running tween. Your CLI login now takes priority over an API key left in your shell.

Features

  • Lint: overlapping_gsap_tweens now also flags a set that fires while a tween on the same element and property is still running, a pattern that plays differently from how it scrubs and exports (5e30bbdbe, #7059).
  • Preview: A video the browser cannot play, such as HEVC without a decoder or ProRes, shows its own frame at the playhead instead of black while its playable copy is made. Copy progress is now reported at Full quality too (eb3562966, #6589).

Fixes

  • Studio: With motion blur on, a scene that draws to a WebGL canvas no longer freezes during preview playback. Motion blur now falls back for those scenes, as it already did in renders (112ba5330, #7060).
  • Core: Preview playback now lands on the same frame as a scrub or an export when a set fires inside a running tween on the same property. Before, a word hidden just before its pop-in ended could stay on screen while playing (0f85af7c7, #7061).
  • CLI: hyperframes cloud render no longer offers --page-motion-blur, because the hosted render API rejected requests that used it. Turn motion blur on in the composition with data-motion-blur="on". Local hyperframes render --page-motion-blur is unchanged (dffc640e8, #7062).
  • CLI: A session from hyperframes auth login now takes priority over HEYGEN_API_KEY and HYPERFRAMES_API_KEY, so a key left in your shell no longer replaces the account you signed in with. The key still wins when HEYGEN_API_URL or HEYGEN_API_BASE points at another host, or when the login cannot refresh (d03bdeae9, #7051).
  • Studio Server: Two exports of the same project started within one second now get their own jobs and output files. Before, the second export replaced the first (92943d99f, #7053).
  • CLI: hyperframes snapshot no longer crashes Chrome on a project with many clips cut from one 4K video. Like render, it now stops Chrome from decoding local videos it already replaces with extracted frames (81b93cf05, #6949).
  • CLI: The latestVersion value in --json output is never older than the CLI you are running, even right after an upgrade (8a6636efe, #7049).
  • CLI: hyperframes auth login --device now works without a terminal, such as in a coding agent's shell or an SSH command. It still refuses to run in CI (de2603e63, #7045).

Docs & Examples

  • Skills: The reverse skill asks once for a credit top-up that covers the whole run when several steps run out at the same time, and builds its project with init --video (05ddddbbf, #7048).
  • Changelog: Added the weekly update for October 26 to November 2, 2026 (6feb4bec7, #7032).
  • Changelog: The v0.9.6 release notes now list four changes they had missed (4ef8c1de5, #7040).

Internal

  • Studio Server: Raised the package size budget to fit the new preview features (b22af8f25, #7044).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.0

Released on 2026-11-02.

Distributed rendering on AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Run now runs only on Plan v2. This is a breaking release: the Plan v1 transport, the planProtocol option and the Plan v1 event and result types are removed. A preview video that runs short of data now holds instead of looping snippets.

Upgrading from 0.8

  • Upgrade the SDK and the deployment together. Redeploy your Lambda stack or Cloud Run service from 0.9.0 when you move your app to the 0.9.0 SDK.
  • Drop planProtocol from renderToLambda and renderToCloudRun calls. Leaving it out, or passing "v2", works as before. Passing "v1" now throws.

  • Removed producer exports: plan, createPlanV2FromV1, publishPlanV2FromV1, readPlanProtocol, readPlanProtocolV1, PLAN_PROTOCOL_V1, CURRENT_PLAN_PROTOCOL, PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION, PLAN_HASH_SCHEMA, PLAN_ARTIFACT_LAYOUT, DISTRIBUTED_RENDER_CAPABILITIES and getDistributedRenderCapabilities, plus their types.   • Producer, AWS Lambda, Cloud Run: Remove the Plan v1 distributed transport (7f48a6894, #6970).

  • CLI: A snapshot still shows what playback shows, whatever other times are asked for (cf1589242, #6720).
  • CLI: The lint summary points at hyperframes lint, not a flag only render takes (98a28cc4b, #6723).
  • Ci: Skills sync steps past the five hidden ClawHub versions blocking it (49e031230, #6713).
  • CLI: An unknown command like search says which command does that (bb4deb801, #6710).
  • CLI: Check says how many browser-playable copies are done while it makes them (2f8c4b1da, #6712).
  • Core: A multi-worker or chunked render lands every frame where an in-order render does (fa9acbd73, #6707).
  • CLI: Check says a lint error is why the browser pass was skipped (11312b359, #6709).
  • CLI: Capture names the network's proxy when it refuses the connection to the site (f0c5db6ea, #6706).
  • CLI: Check waits as long as the --timeout it was given before it counts as idle (6c1765933, #6705).
  • CLI: Audio windows read beats off the whole clip; beats snap to the signal and mark silence (4fa5f5451, #6692).
  • Producer: A BeginFrame capture that draws no first frame in 20 s switches to screenshot (a5496b188, #6701).
  • CLI: Media-treatment --capability preset finds the presets area (cfa653af4, #6700).
  • CLI: A Windows render no longer prints taskkill's already-exited message (ac449555f, #6698).
  • CLI: Snapshot reads https video in the Desktop app instead of failing at ffprobe (0620067eb, #6699).
  • CLI: A stopped model download resumes on the next run instead of starting over (81959201f, #6694).
  • CLI: Media-treatment finds an area by the name its overview prints (2c3d1e07f, #6675).
